browser.observed: Incomplete contact visibly rejected.
Contact name and relationship persisted after a real reload.
Signup visibly explains Patient and Volunteer before requesting credentials.
Pending volunteer cannot enable readiness.
Admin approval button disabled until manager checklist exists.
Missing card id shows guidance and no send button.
Manager checklist stored; final admin approval still required.
App updated from pending to approved without re-login.
Reporter advanced after backend acknowledgement while volunteer was OFF.
All three unknown answers sent without reporter phone.
OSM embed refused connection after coordinate changes on both local cards; sending was still acknowledged. Volunteer route tested separately.
Late readiness received two distinct offers at 351 m and 1133 m; modal switches between them.
Assigned volunteer sees correct Patient/contact and no reporter phone.
OSRM returned a 0.53 km reference route; this is not a real journey/GPS test.
Leaflet markers and OSRM route displayed, but app reported some map tiles unavailable.
Second-case accept button disabled while another incident is active.
Completion cleared private patient panel and left volunteer OFF.
Reporter received cancellation state and disabled form.
Actual cloud viewport 468x844; local app viewport 1280x720. Requested 390px override did not apply to local background tab; no 390px or real-phone acceptance claimed.
Reporter sees completed session and form disabled.

openFindings.detail: All 8 business stages passed; alert p95 20011ms/max20080ms and some API maxima above the existing 15000ms threshold. Not the deployed HTTP backend; cause not conclusively established.
OSM preview iframe refused connection after coordinate changes; some Leaflet tiles failed while route/markers worked. No claim that maps fully passed.
Unresolved npm advisories; package counts are not distinct exploit counts.
APK resources verified; no real phone delivery/audio/GPS evidence collected.
